actions.add_tags_to_record.description: Adds tags to a Vtiger record.
actions.add_tags_to_record.props.recordI: Vtiger webservice ID of the record, for example 12x345. Get it from Search Module Records, Query Records or a previous create.
actions.convert_lead.description: Converts a Lead into a Contact, and optionally an Organization and a Deal.
actions.convert_lead.props.accountFields: Optional JSON of Accounts fields, for example {"accountname": "Acme"}.
actions.convert_lead.props.assignedTo.de: Webservice ID of the user who will own the new records. Defaults to the connected user.
actions.convert_lead.props.contactFields: Optional JSON of extra Contacts fields. Lead values are mapped automatically.
actions.convert_lead.props.leadId.descri: Webservice ID of the Leads record, for example 10x123.
actions.convert_lead.props.potentialFiel: JSON of Potentials fields; required when Create Deal is on, for example {"potentialname": "Acme deal", "closingdate": "2026-12-31", "sales_stage": "Prospecting"}.
actions.create_module_record.description: Creates a record in any Vtiger module from a JSON object of field values.
actions.create_module_record.props.field: JSON object of field API name to value, for example {"lastname": "Smith", "email": "jo@example.com"}.
actions.create_module_record.props.modul: API name of the Vtiger module, for example Contacts, Leads, Accounts, Potentials or Cases. Get the exact names from List Modules.
actions.create_record.props.record.descr: Add new fields to be created in the new record
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_record.props.record.descr: Add new fields to be created in the new record
actions.delete_record_by_id.description: Deletes a Vtiger record (moves it to the Recycle Bin).
actions.delete_record_by_id.props.record: Vtiger webservice ID of the record, for example 12x345. Get it from Search Module Records, Query Records or a previous create.
actions.describe_module.description: Lists the fields of a Vtiger module with their types and allowed values.
actions.describe_module.props.module.des: API name of the Vtiger module, for example Contacts, Leads, Accounts, Potentials or Cases. Get the exact names from List Modules.
actions.download_attachment.description: Downloads an image attachment of a Vtiger record as a file.
actions.download_attachment.props.attach: Value from the record's imageattachmentids field.
actions.find_or_create_record.descriptio: Returns the record whose field equals a value, or creates it when none exists.
actions.find_or_create_record.props.fiel: JSON of fields used only when a record is created; include the mandatory fields, for example {"lastname": "Smith"}.
actions.find_or_create_record.props.matc: Field API name to match on, for example email.
Value the field must equal exactly.
actions.find_or_create_record.props.modu: API name of the Vtiger module, for example Contacts, Leads, Accounts, Potentials or Cases. Get the exact names from List Modules.
actions.find_records_by_email_or_phone.d: Finds Contacts, Leads or Accounts that have a given email address or phone number.
Find Records by Email or Phone
actions.find_records_by_email_or_phone.p: Module API names to search in. Defaults to Contacts, Leads and Accounts.
The email address or phone number to look for.
actions.get_account_hierarchy.descriptio: Returns the parent and child accounts of an Organization.
actions.get_account_hierarchy.props.acco: Webservice ID of an Accounts (Organizations) record, for example 11x42.
actions.get_current_user.description: Returns the Vtiger user the connection authenticates as.
actions.get_picklist_dependency.descript: Returns which target picklist values are allowed for each source picklist value.
actions.get_picklist_dependency.props.mo: API name of the Vtiger module, for example Contacts, Leads, Accounts, Potentials or Cases. Get the exact names from List Modules.
actions.get_picklist_dependency.props.so: API name of the controlling picklist field (from Describe Module).
actions.get_picklist_dependency.props.ta: API name of the dependent picklist field (from Describe Module).
actions.get_record.props.record.descript: Add new fields to be created in the new record
actions.get_record_by_id.description: Retrieves one Vtiger record by its webservice ID.
Vtiger webservice ID of the record, for example 12x345. Get it from Search Module Records, Query Records or a previous create.
actions.get_record_tags.description: Lists the tags on a Vtiger record.
actions.get_record_tags.props.recordId.d: Vtiger webservice ID of the record, for example 12x345. Get it from Search Module Records, Query Records or a previous create.
actions.link_records.description: Adds a record to a related list of another record.
actions.link_records.props.relatedRecord: Webservice ID of the record to add.
actions.link_records.props.relationLabel: Relation label from List Relation Types, for example Contacts.
actions.link_records.props.sourceRecordI: Webservice ID of the parent record.
actions.list_changed_records.description: Lists record IDs created, updated or deleted in a module since a point in time.
actions.list_changed_records.props.modif: Unix seconds (e.g. 1735689600) or an ISO 8601 date such as 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.
actions.list_changed_records.props.modul: API name of the Vtiger module, for example Contacts, Leads, Accounts, Potentials or Cases. Get the exact names from List Modules.
actions.list_modules.description: Lists the Vtiger modules the connected user can access.
actions.list_related_records.description: Lists the records in one related list of a Vtiger record.
actions.list_related_records.props.recor: Webservice ID of the parent record, for example 11x42.
actions.list_related_records.props.relat: The relation label from List Relation Types (its label, not the translated label), for example Contacts or Activities.
API name of the related module, for example Contacts.
actions.list_relation_types.description: Lists the related lists (relations) a Vtiger module has.
actions.list_relation_types.props.module: API name of the source module, for example Accounts.
actions.make_api_call.description: Performs an arbitrary authorized API call. (Deprecated)
actions.make_api_call.props.data.descrip: Enter the data to pass. if its POST, it will be sent as body data, and if GET, as query string
actions.make_api_call.props.headers.desc: Enter the desired request headers. Skip the authorization headers
actions.make_api_call.props.method.descr: Select the HTTP method you want to use
actions.make_api_call.props.url.descript: Path (e.g. /me, /listtypes, /describe) called against the REST base, or an absolute URL on the connected instance.
actions.make_api_call.props.urlPath.desc: Deprecated. Use 'URL' instead. API endpoint's URL path (example: /me, /listtypes, /describe)
actions.query_records.props.query.descri: Enter the query statement, e.g. SELECT count(*) FROM Contacts; Add LIMIT offset, count to page through large results.
actions.query_related_records.descriptio: Pages through the related records of one module linked to a Vtiger record.
actions.query_related_records.props.reco: Webservice ID of the parent record, for example 11x42.
actions.query_related_records.props.rela: The relation label from List Relation Types (its label, not the translated label), for example Contacts or Activities.
API name of the related module, for example Contacts.
actions.remove_tags_from_record.descript: Removes tags from one Vtiger record.
actions.remove_tags_from_record.props.re: Vtiger webservice ID of the record, for example 12x345. Get it from Search Module Records, Query Records or a previous create.
actions.remove_tags_from_record.props.ta: Tag names to remove from this record.
actions.reopen_record.description: Reopens a closed Vtiger record such as a won or lost deal.
actions.reopen_record.props.recordId.des: Vtiger webservice ID of the record, for example 12x345. Get it from Search Module Records, Query Records or a previous create.
actions.search_module_records.descriptio: Finds records in a Vtiger module whose fields match the given values.
actions.search_module_records.props.filt: JSON object of field API name to value, for example {"lastname": "Smith", "leadsource": "Web Site"}.
actions.search_module_records.props.modu: API name of the Vtiger module, for example Contacts, Leads, Accounts, Potentials or Cases. Get the exact names from List Modules.
actions.search_records.props.fields.desc: Enter your filter criteria. Unchecked checkboxes are ignored.
actions.search_records.props.limit.descr: Enter the maximum number of records to return (default and maximum 1000).
actions.unlink_records.description: Removes a record from a related list of another record. Both records stay.
actions.unlink_records.props.relatedReco: Webservice ID of the linked record.
actions.unlink_records.props.sourceRecor: Webservice ID of the parent record.
actions.update_record.props.id.descripti: The record's id. Only the first 100 records of the module are listed; use an expression to pass another id.
actions.update_record.props.record.descr: Fields to update. Values shown are the record values when the step was configured.
actions.update_record_fields.description: Changes only the given fields of a Vtiger record.
actions.update_record_fields.props.field: JSON object of only the fields to change, for example {"leadstatus": "Contacted"}.
actions.update_record_fields.props.recor: Vtiger webservice ID of the record, for example 12x345. Get it from Search Module Records, Query Records or a previous create.
auth.description:
To obtain your Access Key, follow these steps:

1. Login to Vtiger CRM:
Open a web browser and log in to your Vtiger CRM instance.

2. Navigate to User Profile:
In the top right corner, click on your profile name.
Select "My Preferences."

3. The system will generate an access key for you.
Copy and securely store the access key. This key will be used for authentication when making API requests.
Note:

Access keys are sensitive information, and they should be kept secure.
Treat the access key like a password. Do not share it publicly or expose it in an insecure manner.
auth.props.instance_url.description: For the instance URL, add the url without the endpoint. For example enter https://<instance>.od2.vtiger.com instead of https://<instance>.od2.vtiger.com/restapi/v1/vtiger/default
description: CRM software for sales, marketing, and support teams
triggers.new_or_updated_record.descripti: Triggers when a new record is introduced or a record is updated. Deleted records are not emitted.
triggers.new_or_updated_record.props.lim: Enter the maximum number of records to return per poll (1 to 1000).
